error.step-parts: The form cannot be assembled from its step files.
error.no-kit: No kit selected: there is no way to know where to import components from.
error.rules-file: The form rules file does not parse — fix it, or validation and behaviour would be printed as stubs.
error.kit-mismatch: The module was printed by kit {module}, but {active} is active: generating would reprint the registry and the page for another kit. Switch the kit in the status bar to the module's kit — or delete schema/registry.ts to reprint the module for the active one.
orphans.title: Step files without a step
orphans.detail: The step was renamed or removed — its files were left alone. Move your edits and delete them.
flat.title: Files of the old layout
flat.detail: Code of the old contract: the module no longer imports these. Move your edits into the new files and delete them.
notify.orphans: Files of steps no longer in the form: {dirs}. They were left alone — move your edits and delete them.
notify.flat: Files of the old layout remain in the form directory ({count}): {files}. The module does not import them — move your edits into the new files and delete them.
legacy-rules.title: Obsolete rules file
legacy-rules.detail: Form rules live in the module code — in validation/ and behavior/. The builder no longer reads this file: move anything you still need into the code, then delete the file.
notify.legacy-rules: The rules file {file} is obsolete: form rules live in the module code. Delete it.
